title: Oven Dried Ethiopian Kale Azifa
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish featuring fermented kale, this recipe uses a bamboo steamer to create a unique and delicious azifa, perfect for a brunch mood. The kale is dried in the oven to create a bouncy texture.

ingredients.name: curly kale
ingredients.notes: stems removed and discarded, leaves coarsely chopped

instructions: In a large bowl, massage the chopped kale with your hands for about 5 minutes to help break down the cell walls and create a softer texture.
In a separate bowl, mix together the water, salt, garlic, and ginger to create the brine.
Add the kale to the brine and let it sit at room temperature for 24 hours to ferment.
After fermentation, preheat the oven to 200 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the kale from the brine and place it in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dry the kale in the oven for 2 hours, or until it reaches a bouncy texture.
In a small bowl, mix together the berbere spice and lemon juice.
Add the spice mixture to the dried kale and toss to combine.
Place the kale mixture in a bamboo steamer and steam for 10 minutes to heat through.
Serve the azifa hot, garnished with sliced fresh ginger and a sprinkle of berbere spice.
